text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The visiting president and chief operations officer of the Coca-Cola Company, Douglas Ivester, on Tuesday gave about Z$500,000 to the Coca-Cola/University of Zimbabwe Forum in Management and Marketing.
Ivester is expected to call on President Robert Mugabe on Wednesday to announce a major investment by his company in the southern African country.
- Stringent visa restrictions introduced by South Africa in 1996 are beginning to take their toll on businesses in both South Africa and Zimbabwe and thousands of jobs are on the line as a result.
